thread:
incbot: :rotating_light: Pager: network - High packet loss and BGP route churn observed from IAD (Ashburn) -> transit BlueRidge between 15:25-15:28 UTC. Affects customer egress to eu-west and some cross-region traffic. Paging oncall: @sam-oncall and peering team @anya-net. link: https://status.blueridge.example/incident/7732

maria-sre: taking this. @sam-oncall are you able to confirm BGP withdraws in our IAD POP? if so, please put a quick summary here and start mitigation runbook.

sam-oncall: looking. i see repeated BGP withdraws for prefixes announced to BlueRidge from iad1-pop. packet loss spikes ~25-40% to eu-west spine. running quick traceroutes now.

sam-oncall: ```
traceroute to 203.0.113.45 (203.0.113.45), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  iad1-edge (10.0.1.1) 0.5 ms 0.4 ms 0.4 ms
 2  iad1-agg (10.0.2.1) 0.8 ms 0.9 ms 0.8 ms
 3  br-transit-1.blueridge.net (198.51.100.1) 12.2 ms 34.7 ms 40.1 ms
 4  br-transit-2.blueridge.net (198.51.100.2) 45.6 ms 46.9 ms 120.3 ms
 5  * * *
packet loss: 38% during sample window
```

anya-net: we see upstream flap on BlueRidge AS64555. They started withdraw/republish cycles at 15:23 UTC, looks like an internal link flap between BR-east and BR-core. their status page is showing an ongoing networking maintenance but no full incident declared yet (https://status.blueridge.example). I'm opening a provider ticket now and attaching our debug traces.

maria-sre: thanks. immediate mitigation options: (1) divert traffic off BlueRidge by adjusting BGP communities/local-pref to prefer NorthEdge backup, (2) ask BlueRidge to damp/stop route churn, (3) temporary announce more-specifics to force paths out other providers. prefer (1) first since faster. @sam-oncall can you run the pref change for IAD egress? document commands used in thread.

sam-oncall: executing route-preference change to prefer NorthEdge for affected prefixes. applying route-map 'PREFER-NORTHEDGE' on iad1 egress towards transit neighbors for customer prefixes. will stage on one border first then roll.

k8s-deploy-bot: deploy: route-map PREFER-NORTHEDGE -> iad1-edge: applied (success). CI: no changes to infra config repo.

sam-oncall: initial changes applied to iad1-edge. rerunning traceroute to sample host:
```
traceroute to 203.0.113.45 (203.0.113.45), 30 hops max
 1  iad1-edge (10.0.1.1) 0.6 ms 0.6 ms 0.5 ms
 2  iad1-agg (10.0.2.1) 0.8 ms 0.9 ms 0.8 ms
 3  ne-transit-1.northedge.net (192.0.2.1) 10.2 ms 10.1 ms 10.0 ms
 4  ...
packet loss: <1% in sample window
```

alex-sales: hearing reports of timeouts from a handful of EU and NY customers ~15:25-15:40 UTC. any ETA on full mitigation and customer-facing note?

maria-sre: mitigation in progress: we diverted majority of traffic off BlueRidge; observed packet loss dropped under 1% for sampled prefixes. still seeing some churn as BlueRidge completes internal recovery. ETA: monitoring for stability, if stable for 30m we'll mark mitigated. please hold customer comms until we confirm stable or unless impacted customer asks for interim note.

anya-net: BlueRidge support acknowledged ticket and provided CAUSE: internal STM link oscillation. they're running local repairs and say they will issue a formal incident update. requesting our BGP dump for 15:20-15:30 UTC for RCA.

derek-eng: changing incident severity to SEV-2 due to customer-facing timeouts across regions. tagging postmortem: network/peering. I'll own the customer impact section, @alex-sales please collect affected customer IDs and symptom windows.

sam-oncall: rolling change to remaining borders now (iad2 then iad3). applying same route-map. will keep watchers patched.

k8s-deploy-bot: deploy: route-map PREFER-NORTHEDGE -> iad2-edge: applied (success).

sam-oncall: all borders updated. aggregate telemetry shows egress packet loss for affected prefixes dropped from 35%->0.8% within 8 minutes of mitigation. latency normalized for most customers.

maria-sre: handoff: I'm going offline for dinner in 30m. @derek-eng please take active monitoring for next 2 hours, then hand back to weekday oncall. created follow-up tasks: (a) postmortem (b) update egress runbook to include pref-fallback play (c) contact BlueRidge for detailed RCA and SLA credit review.

derek-eng: ack, taking 2h watch. will escalate to infra lead if BlueRidge churn resumes. I'm also scheduling a postmortem kickoff for tomorrow 1000 UTC.

alex-sales: collecting customer IDs now and will prepare a short impact note for affected accounts. will coordinate with support to send interim advisory if any customers reach out.

incbot: Incident logged: INC-20260315-1912345678. Severity: SEV-2. Mitigation: traffic diversion to NorthEdge completed. Owner: derek-eng. Follow-ups created: 3 (postmortem, runbook update, provider RCA ticket).

maria-sre: closing thread for active mitigation — monitoring to confirm stability. thanks team :heart:
